issues.description: In the template, the attributes `lectureName` and `numberOfInscribedStudents` are declared as `public` fields, but the UML in the problem statement specifies all lecture attributes as private ("-") and the reference solution implements them as `private` with getters/setters. This inconsistency can mislead students into keeping the public fields (or duplicating them) instead of matching the UML and intended encapsulation.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the two existing template fields to `private` (not `public`) and ensure the class defines exactly the five UML attributes once: `private String lectureName; private int numberOfInscribedStudents; private int numberOfGuestStudents; private int numberOfLecturers; private int numberOfTutors;`.
